insufficient_signal_pattern.purpose: Explicit ok:false sentinel preventing scorers from rendering misleading letter grades for empty/degenerate inputs.

scanner_exclusions.purpose: IGNORE_DIRS set, TEST_FILE_PATTERNS regex array, stripComments, shouldScanFile.
scanner_exclusions.contract: Zero-I/O scorers cannot enforce; callers MUST pre-filter. excludedPaths field round-trips for audit.

methodology_contract.purpose: Methodology interface, scoreToGrade (throws on InsufficientSignalResult), clamp, roundScore. Every framework exports a METHODOLOGY constant of this shape.

findings: Every framework module exposes a single METHODOLOGY constant + analyzeX function + types. Architectural conformance across 14 modules is uniform.

6 of 14 frameworks (iso-25010, solid, clean-arch, hexagonal, eda, conways-law) honour the InsufficientSignalResult contract. The 8 detection-only / no-score frameworks (eip, wardley, ddd, c4, monorepo, twelve-factor, dora-predicted, auto-detect) do not need it; only twelve-factor and monorepo could plausibly use it (all-unknown input, zero capabilities) and currently fall through to score=25/100/0 respectively — advisory delta noted.
Layer/element classification across clean-arch, hexagonal, ddd, c4 depends on caller-side naming heuristics — all four methodologies disclose this honestly.

iso-25010.spec_summary: ISO/IEC 25010:2011 Software product quality model — 8 top-level characteristics (functional suitability, performance efficiency, compatibility, usability, reliability, security, maintainability, portability) decomposed into 31 sub-characteristics. The standard is normative and gates procurement / acceptance in many regulated industries.

citations.label: ISO/IEC 25010:2011 Systems and software Quality Requirements and Evaluation (SQuaRE) — System and software quality models

iso-25010.expected_outputs: Per-characteristic 0-100 score, overall = mean. Empty/unscanned repo MUST NOT silently render a letter grade.

deltas.rationale: Disclosed in methodology.honestGap — Compatibility's static signal inverts the ISO definition; Usability requires runtime user feedback. Ships 6 of 8.

Weights inside each LOCKED_FORMULA are hand-calibrated (functional_suitability uses 0.6/0.4 coverage/drift split; reliability uses 0.5/0.4 coherence/drift + trend bonus). ISO 25010 does not normatively prescribe weights — drift is editorial, not standards-violating.
Empirical fix (iso-2): the prior linear 15× cliff sent 4 hits to F regardless of provenance. The log2 curve is documented in methodology and honestGap.
Empirical fix (iso-1): empty repo used to score D. Now returns ok:false reason:no_input.

recommendations: Document weight calibration provenance once labelled dataset exists.
Surface excludedPaths in handbook output for audit-trail completeness.

solid.spec_summary: Five object-oriented design principles — Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion. Originally collected by Robert C. Martin in the early 2000s; the SOLID acronym is from Michael Feathers.

provenance.author: Robert C. Martin (collection); Michael Feathers (SOLID acronym)
provenance.book: Agile Software Development, Principles, Patterns, and Practices (Prentice Hall, 2002); Clean Architecture (Prentice Hall, 2017)

citations.label: Robert C. Martin — Agile Software Development, Principles, Patterns, and Practices (2002, Prentice Hall)
Robert C. Martin — Clean Architecture (2017, Prentice Hall)

solid.expected_outputs: Per-principle strength (strong/moderate/needs_work) with confidence. Overall = mean over scored principles. Per-principle 'missing_language' opt-out so Go/Rust don't get penalised for lacking classical inheritance.

deltas.rationale: Discrete buckets avoid over-claiming precision from coarse heuristics; documented in methodology.honestGap.
Weakest signal in the catalog. Disclosed in methodology.honestGap.
Empirical fix (solid-1): zero direct-infra imports alone awarded A+; now requires positive abstraction signal.
Go/Rust no classical inheritance → LSP N/A; Python/Ruby duck-typed → LSP+ISP N/A. Excluded from mean.

recommendations: Strengthen LSP detection beyond substring match (AST-based override analysis) when an AST signal feed is available.

clean-arch.spec_summary: Concentric architectural layers (Entities → Use Cases → Interface Adapters → Frameworks & Drivers) governed by the Dependency Rule: source code dependencies point only inward. Synthesises Hexagonal, Onion, BCE, and DCI into a single diagram.

provenance.author: Robert C. Martin
provenance.source: Blog post 'The Clean Architecture' (2012); book Clean Architecture (Prentice Hall, 2017)

citations.label: Robert C. Martin — 'The Clean Architecture' (2012, cleancoder.com)
Robert C. Martin — Clean Architecture: A Craftsman's Guide to Software Structure and Design (2017, Prentice Hall)

clean-arch.expected_outputs: Score 0-100 with violations penalised by severity (critical/medium/adjacent). Empty registry → not A+ (symmetric counterpart to ISO empty=D bug).

deltas.rationale: Empirical fix (ca-1): 7 criticals previously flattened score to 0; caps preserve diagnostic resolution.
Empirical fix (ca-2): symmetric counterpart of ISO empty=D bug.
Disclosed in honestGap. >30% unknown surfaces unknownLayerInsight.

recommendations: Consider per-graph-size normalisation as an optional view (not a replacement) for users with >1000-cap registries.

hexagonal.spec_summary: A core domain surrounded by inbound/outbound Ports that primary (driver) and secondary (driven) Adapters plug into. The Dependency Rule directs all edges from adapters into the core — never the reverse.

citations.label: Cockburn — Ports and Adapters (canonical write-up archived at WikiWikiWeb)

hexagonal.expected_outputs: Score 0-100. Empty / missing-core registry MUST return insufficient — grade A+ next to a missingCore=true flag is contradictory.

deltas.rationale: Empirical fix (hex-2): 9 violations alone pegged at 0; cap preserves diagnostic value.
Empirical fix (hex-1): a registry with adapters but no core is not a hexagon. Coupling grade and structural flag.

recommendations: Could expose port-orientation (inbound vs outbound) as a signal in a future revision.

eip.spec_summary: 65 messaging patterns organised into channels, routers, transformers, endpoints, and orchestrators. The lingua franca for asynchronous integration architecture.

citations.label: Hohpe — Conversations Between Loosely Coupled Services (canonical companion essays)

eip.expected_outputs: Detection-only — per-pattern present/possible/absent, no 0-100 score, architecture-type label.

deltas.rationale: Practical subset spanning all 5 categories. Editorial choice — adding patterns is additive and does not shift any number.
Empirical fix (eip-2): \bbus\b matched business/omnibus/busy.
Empirical fix (eip-2): \bfilter\b matched every UI filter.
Empirical fix (eip-5): no patterns ≠ point-to-point.
Empirical fix (eip-6): avoid 'recommend Dead Letter' noise on a single bus hit.

recommendations: Expand pattern set to include Channel Adapter, Wire Tap, Recipient List in a future minor release.

eda.spec_summary: Event-Driven Architecture — components communicate via published events. Pattern catalog: event notification, event-carried state transfer, event sourcing, CQRS, saga.

provenance.author: Martin Fowler (consolidation); Greg Young (event sourcing/CQRS); Ben Stopford (streaming systems)
provenance.source: Fowler, 'What do you mean by Event-Driven?' (2017); Stopford, 'Designing Event-Driven Systems' (O'Reilly, 2018)

citations.label: Fowler — 'What do you mean by Event-Driven?' (martinfowler.com, 2017)
Stopford — Designing Event-Driven Systems (O'Reilly, 2018; free download via Confluent)

eda.expected_outputs: hasEda boolean + 0..1 confidence + confidenceBand. Below corroboration floor → InsufficientSignalResult.

deltas.rationale: Empirical fix: prior binary 'any-count > 0' weighting treated 1 file == 1000 files.
Empirical fix: single weak signal no longer claims EDA.
Prevents downstream UIs from reinventing thresholds.

recommendations: Revisit SATURATION_N=3 once empirical telemetry on real-repo file counts is available.

conways-law.spec_summary: 'Any organization that designs a system will produce a design whose structure is a copy of the organization's communication structure.' Implemented as a structural proxy (ownership + cross-team edges + CODEOWNERS), with the original-law claim explicitly disclaimed via requiresHumanVerification.

provenance.author: Melvin E. Conway
provenance.paper: How Do Committees Invent? — Datamation, vol. 14 no. 4 (1968)

citations.label: Skelton & Pais — Team Topologies (IT Revolution, 2019) — modern operationalisation of Conway's Law
MacCormack, Baldwin, Rusnak — 'Exploring the duality between product and organizational architectures' (HBS Working Paper 08-039, 2008)

conways-law.expected_outputs: Single-team repo → InsufficientSignalResult (Conway's Law is undefined). Multi-team → 0-100 with verdict band.

deltas.rationale: Empirical fix: solo repos used to show grade D verdict undefined.
Conway's Law is an organizational claim; the package can only compute a code-derived proxy.

recommendations: Consider exposing per-team coupling matrix output for org-design dashboards.

wardley.spec_summary: Wardley Mapping: capabilities plotted on (X) evolution axis (Genesis → Custom-Built → Product → Commodity) against (Y) value-chain visibility. Strategic tool for evolutionary positioning.

provenance.author: Simon Wardley
provenance.source: Online book 'Wardley Maps' (CC BY-SA 4.0) on Medium; learnwardleymapping.com

citations.label: Simon Wardley — Wardley Maps (Medium, CC BY-SA 4.0)
Wardley map canvas + glossary (cc-by-sa, learnwardleymapping.com glossary)

wardley.expected_outputs: Per-capability stage + 0..1 score + confidence + disputed flag + signals[]. analyzeWardley returns plotted components with deterministic seeded jitter.

deltas.rationale: Empirical fix (wardley-2): single regex match used to return 0.82-0.97 confidence.
Empirical fix (wardley-1): 'Custom Auth' with criticality=critical no longer commoditised.
Empirical fix (wardley-3): file-count alone no longer promotes nascent capabilities to 'core custom'.

recommendations: Expand value-chain map beyond e-commerce-shaped keywords as additional domain datasets become available.

twelve-factor.spec_summary: 12 principles for SaaS apps: codebase, dependencies, config, backing services, build/release/run, processes, port binding, concurrency, disposability, dev/prod parity, logs, admin processes.

citations.label: Hoffman — Beyond the Twelve-Factor App (O'Reilly, 2016) — adds 3 factors

deltas.rationale: Methodology honestGap: 'Most factors map to binary file-existence proxies upstream — not deep validations'.
Does NOT emit InsufficientSignalResult on all-unknown input — diverges from the iso/clean/hex/eda pattern. Defensible (each factor's status IS the caller's claim) but inconsistent with shared infra.

recommendations: Consider returning InsufficientSignalResult when factors.length === 0 (empty input is structurally different from all-unknown).

monorepo.spec_summary: Cross-package intelligence for monorepos. Build-system identification + per-capability isolation health (cross-target dep count → 100 − 10·deps).

provenance.author: Industrial practice (Google, Facebook, then Bazel/Pants/Turborepo/Nx/Lerna)
provenance.source: Potvin & Levenberg, 'Why Google Stores Billions of Lines of Code in a Single Repository' (CACM Vol. 59 No. 7, 2016)

citations.label: Potvin & Levenberg — Why Google Stores Billions of Lines of Code in a Single Repository (Communications of the ACM 59:7, 2016)

deltas.rationale: Methodology honestGap: 'chosen for legibility, not derived from empirical data'.
Could return InsufficientSignalResult on empty input for symmetry with iso/clean/hex.

recommendations: Calibrate the -10 slope against measured-vs-perceived-health data when available.

dora-predicted.spec_summary: DORA's 4 keys (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, MTTR). This module predicts the LEVELS from architectural signals — not from CI/CD logs. Subpath name carries the disclaimer.

provenance.author: Nicole Forsgren, Jez Humble, Gene Kim + DORA team
provenance.book: Accelerate (IT Revolution, 2018); annual State of DevOps Report (2014–)

citations.label: Google Cloud DORA — Accelerate State of DevOps Report 2023

dora-predicted.expected_outputs: 4 levels (elite/high/medium/low) + overall. Honest gap discloses this is prediction, not measurement.

deltas.rationale: Disclosed in subpath name AND methodology.honestGap. Not a divergence from spec, but consumers must understand the distinction.
Mirror the prism0x2A dashboard; not derived from labelled DORA-outcome data.

recommendations: When real CI/CD log integration exists, add an analyzeDoraMeasured companion module so the 'predicted' suffix remains meaningful.

ddd.spec_summary: DDD strategic patterns — Bounded Contexts, Ubiquitous Language, Context Maps with relationship patterns (Partnership, Shared Kernel, Customer-Supplier, Conformist, Anticorruption Layer, Open Host Service, Published Language, Separate Ways, Big Ball of Mud).

provenance.author: Eric Evans (strategic patterns); Vaughn Vernon (tactical operationalisation)

citations.label: Eric Evans — Domain-Driven Design: Tackling Complexity in the Heart of Software (Addison-Wesley, 2003)
Evans — Domain-Driven Design Reference (free PDF, domainlanguage.com)

ddd.expected_outputs: No 0-100 score. Subdomain classification + relationship inference + ubiquitous-language extraction. Aggregation counts.

deltas.rationale: Customer-Supplier, Published Language, Separate Ways not surfaced; 'partnership' subsumes shared_kernel in mutual-deps branch per dashboard parity.
Methodology honestGap: 'a custom-built solution whose name contains auth will be classified generic'. Mitigated by criticality override.

recommendations: Add explicit shared_kernel branch when callers can supply a 'shared module' signal independent of mutual dependency.

c4.spec_summary: Hierarchical 4-level architecture diagram set: System Context (L1), Container (L2), Component (L3), Code (L4). UML-agnostic, designed for visual communication.

citations.label: Simon Brown — Software Architecture for Developers (Leanpub, 2012–)
Structurizr DSL — reference implementation by C4's author

c4.expected_outputs: Coverage report (which levels populated) + capability classification helpers. Code/L4 explicitly out of scope.

deltas.rationale: Disclosed in methodology.coverage. Code-level diagrams are auto-generated via IDE introspection in practice — not in scope for this pure-function package.

recommendations: Document the Code-level non-coverage in README so consumers know not to look for L4 helpers.

auto-detect.spec_summary: Meta-detector that classifies frameworks and architectural style from package.json + directory layout. Not a published spec — internal heuristic catalog with disclosed confidence.
auto-detect.expected_outputs: Detected frameworks (with version, confidence, signals) + ArchitectureStyleResult (primary + confidence + rationale).

deltas.rationale: Methodology honestGap: 'calibrated by hand, not from a labelled dataset'.

deltas.implemented: hexagonal > clean > ddd > event_driven > microservices > layered_nestjs > layered_traditional > unknown
deltas.rationale: Documented order; mirrors dashboard parity. Fixed precedence means a project with BOTH hexagonal AND clean dirs will be labelled hexagonal.

recommendations: Promote confidence values to a calibration table backed by a labelled fixture corpus.
